description: One call for "should I buy a The Standard Reserve (TSR) Branch or license right now" on Robinhood Chain. Bundles Days of Issuance (1s_std_branches_doi), the ETH cost of a license via the pool vs. the charter-auction path (1s_std_license_cost, with cheapest_path), recent license-auction day history, the policy outlook, and any pending governance change affecting licenses/day or issuance -- plus per-charter license headroom when charterId is given. Each part comes back under parts.<name> with its own status (ok, not_ready, or error); one part failing never fails the whole call. summary carries the handful of numbers a buyer looks at first, including next_day_starts_at and seconds_to_next_day for when the current auction day rolls over.

charter_id.description: Charter id (decimal string). Adds parts.license_headroom for this charter's remaining licenses today.
